description: Fixed-placement fixture for Shri Ram's chart. There is no date or time, so it tests dignity, varga and dasha-lord logic only, never ephemeris accuracy (spec section 1, corrections 1-4).
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Bala Kanda 18.8-9: Karka lagna, Moon in Punarvasu with Jupiter in Karka, five exalted planets (Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn). Degrees as fixed in the spec section 1 corrections and the Task 12 brief: exalted planets at their exaltation points, Moon at Karka 1 deg (Punarvasu pada 4).

not_asserted.mercury: commonly cited placement, not stated in the source verses
